description: Wrong loop boundary causes index overflow
buggy_code:
data = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]

total = 0
for i in range(len(data) + 1):
    total += data[i]

print(f"Total: {total}")
traceback:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "loop.py", line 5, in <module>
    total += data[i]
IndexError: list index out of range

ground_truth.root_cause: Loop uses range(len(data) + 1) which goes from 0 to 5, but valid indices are 0-4 — should be range(len(data))
